mapper.sql: FROM ( SELECT a.* , f_cdnm('ProgramType', scm30_program_type, #{companyId}, f_sysdate()) AS scm30_program_type_nm , b.sys10_file_id AS scm30_file_id , b.sys10_parent_id AS scm30_file_parent_id , b.sys10_file_nm AS scm30_file_nm , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY scm30_system_cd, scm30_program_type, scm30_program_cd ORDER BY scm30_version DESC) AS rn FROM scm30_program a LEFT OUTER JOIN sys10_file b ON a.scm30_program_id = b.sys10_parent_id WHERE scm30_system_cd = #{systemCode} AND coalesce(scm30_use_yn, 'false') LIKE #{useYn} ) t WHERE rn = 1 AND scm30_program_type LIKE #{programType} AND UPPER(CONCAT(scm30_program_type_nm, scm30_program_cd, scm30_program_nm, scm30_note, scm30_file_nm)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText})
mapper.select:
SELECT scm30_program_id AS program_id , scm30_system_cd AS system_cd , scm30_program_type AS program_type , scm30_program_cd AS program_cd , scm30_program_nm AS program_nm , scm30_source AS source , scm30_version AS version , scm30_person_id AS person_id , scm30_reg_date AS reg_date , scm30_note AS note , scm30_use_yn AS use_yn , f_cdnm('SystemCode', scm30_system_cd, #{companyId}, f_sysdate()) AS system_nm , scm30_program_type_nm AS program_type_nm , to_char(scm30_reg_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS reg_date_str , scm30_file_id AS file_id , scm30_file_parent_id AS file_parent_id , scm30_file_nm AS file_nm
ORDER BY scm30_system_cd, scm30_program_type, scm30_program_cd LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT scm30_program.scm30_program_id AS program_id , scm30_system_cd AS system_cd , scm30_program_type AS program_type , scm30_program_cd AS program_cd , scm30_program_nm AS program_nm , scm30_source AS source , scm30_version AS version , scm30_person_id AS person_id , scm30_reg_date AS reg_date , scm30_note AS note , scm30_use_yn AS use_yn , sys10_file_id AS file_id , sys10_parent_id AS file_parent_id , sys10_file_nm AS file_nm , f_cdnm('SystemCode', scm30_system_cd, #{companyId}, f_sysdate()) AS system_nm , f_cdnm('ProgramType', scm30_program_type, #{companyId}, f_sysdate()) AS program_type_nm , to_char(scm30_reg_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS reg_date_str , to_char(scm13_deploy_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS deploy_date_str , f_emp_kor_nm(scm30_person_id) AS person_nm FROM scm30_program LEFT OUTER JOIN sys10_file ON scm30_program.scm30_program_id = sys10_parent_id LEFT OUTER JOIN scm13_dev_program ON scm30_program.scm30_program_id = scm13_program_id WHERE scm30_system_cd = #{systemCode} AND scm30_program_type = #{programType} AND scm30_program_cd LIKE #{programCode} ORDER BY scm30_version

SELECT scm30_program_id AS program_id , scm30_system_cd AS system_cd , scm30_program_type AS program_type , scm30_program_cd AS program_cd , scm30_program_nm AS program_nm , scm30_source AS source , scm30_version AS version , scm30_person_id AS person_id , scm30_reg_date AS reg_date , scm30_note AS note , scm30_use_yn AS use_yn , f_cdnm('SystemCode', scm30_system_cd, 1, f_sysdate()) AS system_nm , f_cdnm('ProgramType', scm30_program_type, 1, f_sysdate()) AS program_type_nm , to_char(scm30_reg_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS reg_date_str , CAST(NULL AS numeric) AS file_id , CAST(NULL AS numeric) AS file_parent_id , CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS file_nm FROM scm30_program WHERE scm30_program_id = #{programId}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO scm30_program (scm30_program_id, scm30_system_cd, scm30_program_type, scm30_program_cd, scm30_program_nm, scm30_source, scm30_version, scm30_person_id, scm30_note, scm30_use_yn) VALUES (#{programId}, #{systemCd}, #{programType}, #{programCd}, #{programNm}, #{source}, #{version}, #{personId}, #{note}, #{useYn}) ON CONFLICT (scm30_program_id) DO UPDATE SET scm30_system_cd = EXCLUDED.scm30_system_cd, scm30_program_type = EXCLUDED.scm30_program_type, scm30_program_cd = EXCLUDED.scm30_program_cd, scm30_program_nm = EXCLUDED.scm30_program_nm, scm30_source = EXCLUDED.scm30_source, scm30_version = EXCLUDED.scm30_version, scm30_person_id = EXCLUDED.scm30_person_id, scm30_note = EXCLUDED.scm30_note, scm30_use_yn = EXCLUDED.scm30_use_yn
